description: Stable product error codes for IPC, vault, and licence surfaces. New codes require a Layer 2 contract amendment — do not invent ad-hoc strings in application code.

conventions.jsonrpc_protocol_layer: JSON-RPC 2.0 reserved codes (-32700 to -32600) apply at the envelope layer; product codes ride in error.data.caseforge_code or map via error.data
conventions.http_not_used: Sidecars use stdio JSON-RPC; these codes are not HTTP status codes
conventions.user_message_rule: message fields below are developer-stable English; UI may localize but must preserve code

jsonrpc_reserved.note: Application/server errors use codes ≤ -32000 per JSON-RPC 2.0 when mapping product failures on the wire
